import re

SOURCE = re.compile(r"^#\s*Reconstructed via infocmp from file: (?P<file>\S.*?)\s*$")
COMMENT = re.compile(r"^#")
NAMES = re.compile(r"^(?P<names>[^\s|,][^,]*),?\s*$")
CAPS = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<caps>\S.*?)\s*$")
CAP = re.compile(r"^(?P<name>[\w.]+)(?:(?P<op>[#=@])(?P<value>.*))?$")
SPLIT = re.compile(r"(?<!\\),")   # a comma inside a string value is escaped as \,


def parse(lines):
    source, terms, caps = {}, [], []
    used_s, used_t, used_c, skip = [], [], [], []
    term = ""
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = SOURCE.match(ln)
        if m:
            source["file"] = m.group("file")
            used_s.append(j)
            continue
        if COMMENT.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        m = CAPS.match(ln)
        if m:
            for cap in SPLIT.split(m.group("caps")):
                cap = cap.strip()
                c = CAP.match(cap)
                if not cap or not c:
                    continue
                op = c.group("op") or ""
                kind = {"": "boolean", "#": "numeric", "=": "string", "@": "cancelled"}[op]
                caps.append({"terminal": term, "capability": c.group("name"), "type": kind,
                             "value": c.group("value") or ""})
            used_c.append(j)
            continue
        m = NAMES.match(ln)
        if m:
            parts = m.group("names").split("|")
            term = parts[0]
            terms.append({"name": parts[0], "aliases": ",".join(parts[1:-1]),
                          "description": parts[-1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""})
            used_t.append(j)
    return {"blocks": [
        {"name": "source", "kind": "kv", "lines": used_s, "records": [source] if source else []},
        {"name": "terminal", "kind": "table", "lines": used_t, "records": terms},
        {"name": "capabilities", "kind": "table", "lines": used_c, "records": caps}],
        "skip": skip}
